caption: A sheet of red plastic is held up in front of the camera, and everything seen through it looks red.

sa.check: A sheet of red plastic is held up in front of the camera.
Everything seen through it looks red.
The scene beyond its edges is normal.
The tint vanishes when the plastic is lowered.

pc.expect: Only the view through the plastic is tinted red; beyond its edges the scene is normal.
pc.fail: The whole scene is red; or the view through the plastic is normal; or the tint is a different colour.

pc.expect: The tint moves with the plastic and would vanish when it is lowered.
pc.fail: It stays put while the plastic moves; or remains after it is lowered; or appears before it is raised.

pc.expect: The scene through the plastic is the same scene, tinted, not a different picture.
pc.fail: A different scene appears; or objects appear that are not there; or the image is mirrored.

pc.expect: The plastic is a thin flexible sheet.
pc.fail: It is rigid glass; or it flows; or it tears.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or the hand passes through it.
It rearranges; or objects move; or the sheet changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
